result.rationale: Tiger closed a 2015 investment in Cleopatra Resources LLC, but fund, vehicle, security, stake and co-investors were undisclosed. After Cleopatra sold substantially all retail assets in 2023, the active perimeter is retained American Natural Supply fuel-terminal/storage/logistics infrastructure, not Giant Oil's retail chain or a predominantly alternative-fuel network.

identityResolution.divestedBusiness: American Natural Retail PA LLC assets
identityResolution.headquarters: ANS: Pittsburgh; Cleopatra's 2022 SEC office: New York
identityResolution.boundary: Exclude Giant-owned retail; keep stations beneath operators.

ownershipResolution.finding: The 2015 release does not prove Fund I or sole ownership. Tiger led 2017 parent equity; one undisclosed investor bought $10 million of equity in 2022. Current Tiger board representation and OIC's unrealized ANS listing support continuing involvement; no full Tiger exit was found.

operatingResolution.historicalMix: 2018: two Energy Centres and 11 conventional gasoline c-stores.
operatingResolution.currentModel: ANS commercial fuel supply, storage, terminals, delivery and management for regional commercial, industrial and Marcellus/Utica customers.
operatingResolution.alternativeFuels: Historical CNG verified; current RNG/EV assets and fuel mix are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.
operatingResolution.basis: Tiger tied its capital to CNG/energy infrastructure; retained ANS is an asset-based B2B terminal/logistics network and ordinary retail was divested.
